output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes the late_fee_cents function. Key fixes: (1) Uses ceiling division for "started periods" calculation instead of floor division; (2) Implements proper half-up rounding by adding 5000 before dividing by 10000; (3) Restructures the cap/minimum logic so the cap takes precedence when the calculated fee exceeds it, while the minimum is applied for lower fees. All test cases pass, and the implementation properly reflects the docstring specification.
